title: A://Labs — Platform Architecture
subtitle: How the Allternit platform surface is built, from shell routing to agents and deployment

modules.title: Module 1: Shell, View Registry & Routing
learningObjectives: Understand how the Vite entrypoint bootstraps the platform shell
Understand how the view registry maps modes to surface components
Understand how ShellRail navigation drives mode switching
Understand how global layout and mode surfaces coexist

modules.title: Module 2: Authentication & Identity
learningObjectives: Understand how auth sessions are managed across browser and platform contexts
Understand how OAuth app configuration drives third-party connections
Understand how the platform auth client negotiates identity
Understand how permissions gates are enforced in the UI

modules.title: Module 3: Data, State & Persistence
learningObjectives: Understand how the Prisma schema models platform data
Understand how Zustand stores manage client-side state
Understand how browser storage persists settings across reloads
Understand how workspace state coordinates across views

modules.title: Module 4: Agents, Canvas & AI Surfaces
learningObjectives: Understand how the agent service exposes platform agents to the UI
Understand how agent mode executor runs agent steps
Understand how canvas artifact events bridge tools and the workspace
Understand how agent vendors map providers to canvas capabilities

modules.title: Module 5: Design System & Deployment
learningObjectives: Understand how design tokens define the platform visual language
Understand how ThemeProvider switches and persists themes
Understand how glass surfaces compose the shell UI
Understand how the Vite build pipeline packages the platform
